name: daintree.markdown-editor
description: Edit Markdown files in place: the file panel's Source view made writable, with syntax highlighting, explicit save, conflict detection against agents writing the same file, and draft recovery.
tagline: Edit the plans, specs and notes your agents write, without leaving the panel

commands.title: Markdown: Recover drafts…
commands.description: List unsaved Markdown drafts whose panel is gone and reopen one in Edit mode in its own project and worktree.
